children.exact_semantic_question: For inventoried documents with document_kind=final_permit, does the issued permit text define the governing authorization corpus by internal part structure (Parts I–III/IV hereof)?
children.semantic_contract: Issued final_permit documents are the primary authorization corpus; enforceable limitations and monitoring conditions are read from named internal parts of the issued permit, not from filename kind alone.
children.scope: permit package documents where document_kind=final_permit across NM0000116, NM0020583, and NM0028762

children.exact_semantic_question: For inventoried documents with document_kind in (part_ii_appendix, part_iv), are they incorporated into the issued final_permit by internal cross-reference rather than standing as independent authorization documents?
children.semantic_contract: Part II appendix and Part IV inventoried files are subordinate parts of the issued final_permit corpus when the corresponding final_permit cross-references them; they do not independently supersede the issued permit.
evidence_grounding: documents/gcc/final_permit.txt lines 149-150 Appendix A of Part II
documents/farmington/final_permit.txt line 213 Part IV of the permit
documents/farmington/final_permit.txt cover page line 25 Part IV hereof
children.scope: permit package documents where document_kind in (part_ii_appendix, part_iv)

children.exact_semantic_question: For inventoried documents with document_kind in (fact_sheet, statement_of_basis), does document text establish draft/proposed explanatory content that defers enforceable limitations to the issued or draft permit rather than standalone authorization?
children.semantic_contract: Fact sheets and statements of basis are supporting draft/proposed or administrative-record documents; they do not independently authorize discharge or establish final enforceable limitations.
evidence_grounding: documents/aztec/statement_of_basis.txt lines 556-558 See the draft permit for limitations
documents/farmington/statement_of_basis.txt lines 1-5 FOR THE DRAFT NPDES PERMIT
children.scope: permit package documents where document_kind in (fact_sheet, statement_of_basis)

children.exact_semantic_question: For inventoried documents with document_kind=reasonable_potential, are they calculation appendices subordinate to fact sheets rather than independent authorization documents?
children.semantic_contract: Reasonable-potential files are WQBEL calculation workbooks appended to the fact sheet / permitting record; they do not independently authorize discharge.
evidence_grounding: documents/aztec/reasonable_potential.txt lines 12-13 APPENDIX A of FACT SHEET
documents/gcc/reasonable_potential.txt lines 4-5 CALCULATIONS OF NEW MEXICO WATER QUALITY-BASED EFFLUENT LIMITATIONS
